issue.title: Backlog epic 1: cmdsub safety, honest retries, durable chop launches, one beads.db owner, triage owners
issue.description: The five most important unowned task beads are fixed and closed: model output can never run host $(cmd), host finalizer failures never re-run an agent, a scheduler stop never silently drops a chop's launch batch, beads.db has one SQLite library owner per process, and check-run triage attaches the owning task bead. The lander then continues the backlog chain with the next five beads.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/backlog_epic_cmdsub_retries_launches.md requests this work

issue.title: Model output never reaches host $(cmd) (sase-1sn)
issue.description: cmdsub: close every model-output and agent-writable channel into host command substitution for human-launched workflows, keeping macro expansion and Jinja semantics.

issue.title: Provider retry never re-runs an agent for a host finalizer failure (sase-1he)
issue.description: retry_scope: type host finalizer and publish failures so provider retry patterns never match them, while real provider 500s still retry.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/backlog_epic_cmdsub_retries_launches.md defines phase retry_scope as one work unit

issue.title: A scheduler stop never silently drops a chop's launch batch (sase-1c2)
issue.description: chop_launch: journal in-flight chop launch batches and resume them idempotently after a scheduler or service-host stop, with visible notices.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/backlog_epic_cmdsub_retries_launches.md defines phase chop_launch as one work unit
